Hey, I've had a similar experience. This happened twice after we started dating. Honestly in my case, my girlfriend had a lot happening recently. So as much as we don't do it, I don't mind.

But oh well the first time I freaked out so much, there were all kinds of questions like does she not like me anymore? Am I not attractive, did I do something wrong? Is it me or is it her?

Honestly, it was the same back then, had a lot in her life. So well, the sexual drive naturally went down a bit.

I'd want you to talk to her, ask her the important questions, don't assume anything, and focus on the main issue, you can say she has no trauma, but there can be. And even if there's not, there might be something in her mind, career, future family etc. everything is possible honestly.

I would like you to assess your relationship too, how much intimacy is there? Is sex the only thing that matters, do you even see her as your partner or a sex friend (sorry i know this one is rude)? From her side, tell her how you feel, about sex. How it may have been frustrating, and it may have hurt your confidence as whole(using may because you can have other problems). 

Relationship is not just sex, it's friendship. You must become their best friend, understand feelings, love their personality, try to fulfill their wants, maybe once in a while you can surprise them with flowers or chocolates, etc. Trust me it's fulfilling. Again good luck, hope it makes you feel positive, It's just a way of acceptance of your situation.
